crossRefs.note: The burden of Dumah. One calls to me out of Seir, “Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?”
The watchman said, “The morning comes, and also the night. If you will inquire, inquire. Come back again.”
In the morning, ‘It will be foul weather today, for the sky is red and threatening.’ Hypocrites! You know how to…
Watch therefore, for you don’t know in what hour your Lord comes.
But concerning the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need that anything be written to you.
So the ship master came to him, and said to him, “What do you mean, sleeper? Arise, call on your God! Maybe your God…
Now while the bridegroom delayed, they all slumbered and slept.
He came to the disciples, and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “What, couldn’t you watch with me for one hour?
Watch and pray, that you don’t enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”
Watch therefore, for you don’t know when the lord of the house is coming, whether at evening, or at midnight, or when…
Wake up righteously, and don’t sin, for some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame.
Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”
You are all children of light and children of the day. We don’t belong to the night, nor to darkness,
Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might; for there is no work, nor plan, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in…
But when these things begin to happen, look up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is near.”
But I say this, brothers: the time is short, that from now on, both those who have wives may be as though they had none;
But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.
But, according to his promise, we look for new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness dwells.
“Behold, I come quickly. My reward is with me, to repay to each man according to his work.
He who testifies these things says, “Yes, I come quickly.” Amen! Yes, come, Lord Jesus.

translations.web: Do this, knowing the time, that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep, for salvation is now nearer to us than when we first believed.
translations.bsb: And do this, understanding the occasion. The hour has come for you to wake up from your slumber, for our salvation is nearer now than when we first believed.
translations.kjv: And that, knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of sleep: for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.
translations.asv: And this, knowing the season, that already it is time for you to awake out of sleep: for now is salvation nearer to us than when we first believed.
